reason: The cited evidence supports the general concept that coherent nanoprecipitates in tungsten-based HEAs can enhance mechanical properties (E1), but it does not address copper addition, thermal conductivity enhancement, or the specific processing route proposed. E2 only describes baseline WMoTaNb powder synthesis and SPS, providing no support for Cu doping or precipitate formation. Thus, most key premises lack specific prior evidence.
premises: Coherent Cu-rich nanoprecipitates can form in WMoTaNb via Cu addition and SPS/heat treatment
These precipitates will be uniformly dispersed and coherent with the matrix
Coherent precipitates enhance thermal conductivity by ~20% via high-conductivity pathways
